headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk analysis to provide up-to-date security and compatibility insights. Leverage machine learning models for predictive analytics on potential issues before installation. Implement a user-friendly interface for easy monitoring of package updates and vulnerabilities.
actions: Implement real-time dependency scanning using machine learning algorithms to detect known vulnerabilities and security risks in installed packages.
Create a dashboard that displays risk scores and potential issues, allowing users to prioritize their actions based on severity levels.
Develop an automated update mechanism that alerts users about critical updates or patches for dependencies, ensuring they stay secure and compatible.
